maya: Quick sync — dedicated roadmap for Q3. I want to float a pilot called 'elastic micro-pools' + a new autoscale mode 'soft-preempt'. Goal: give small customers predictable reserved perf while letting bursts spill into a low-cost shared cushion. Need scope, launch criteria, and any hard blockers from infra/ops.
ryan: digging this. key questions: how do we account burst usage (billing + quota)? and what's the preemption signal for soft-preempt?
maya: good q. proposal: billing = reserved hourly + burst metered per-second at a lower priority rate. Quota-wise, tenants get a reserved slab and a spillover allowance that drains from a shared buffer. Preemption signal = queue-latency + occupancy threshold (if buffer < 10% -> preempt).
ana: from SRE POV: we need deterministic drain plan. soft-preempt should do graceful throttles (token-bucket ramp-down) not evict. if we allow graceful degradation, oncall risk goes down.
sam: CS: customers ask for guaranteed p99 latency for reserved. They will accept best-effort for burst. But need clear SLAs in onboarding docs.
ryan: infra constraints: implementing shared buffer requires cross-tenant accounting + fast atomic updates. We can approximate with per-pool counters + periodic reconcile. That changes failure modes.
maya: tradeoffs noted. For scope, propose MVP that uses: 1) reserved micro-pools (configurable min GPUs), 2) per-tenant reserved slab + per-tenant spill allowance, 3) soft-preempt policy implemented in runtime with token-bucket ramp-down. Defer global reconciler to next phase.
ana: launch criteria suggestions: - e2e tests for preemption ramp (simulate 5x reserved load) - no-regression latency benchmarks on a set of 5 tenant profiles - observability dashboards showing buffer occupancy, preempt events - rollback plan: immediate disable spillover flag per pool.
maya: + product launch gating: 2 pilot customers signed, run for 4 weeks, no P1s, agreed SLAs in contract.
ryan: implementation notes: runtime changes: add spill flag, token-bucket limiter per-tenant, buffer-tracking metric. scheduler changes: pick spillable instances and route there. ETA for a small sprint team (2 infra, 1 runtime) = 6 weeks.
sam: legal: need to surface burst billing spikes to customers. we'll draft language: "Burst usage billed at Spot-rate-equivalent; capped weekly to X% of reserved unless opted-in." Will follow up.
ana: oncall playbook snippet: "If buffer occupancy < 5% for >3m then page infra-oncall; use rollback command: `/pool update <id> --spill=false`". ops-bot: Recorded plan: rollout-flat: staged -> 3 pools -> monitor 72h -> expand.
maya: action items: @ryan scope PR for runtime changes (due EOW), @ana run simulated preempt tests next week, @sam draft customer pilot contract. We'll reconvene Thu 10am PT. :thumbsup:
